summary: Complete frontend testing of SignaTouch product page - all 9 features tested and working correctly. New digital signage kiosk product line page at /signatouch with elegant design, amber/gold accent colors, and AI-generated kiosk images.

features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='signatouch-landing', hero section displays correctly with kiosk background image

features_tested.feature: SignaTouch navigation link appears in navbar with amber color
features_tested.details: NavLink found with data-testid='nav-signatouch', color rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.8) - amber color confirmed, navigation to /signatouch works

features_tested.feature: Hero section displays with background image and CTAs
features_tested.details: Hero shows kiosk image from emergentagent CDN, 'DIGITAL SIGNAGE SOLUTIONS' label (amber), 'SIGNATOUCH' title, 'Interactive Kiosks. Elevated Experiences.' tagline, 'Request Quote' (links to /contact) and 'View Products' (links to #products) CTAs

features_tested.feature: Products section shows 3 kiosk types with images
features_tested.details: Found all 3 products: Touch Screen Kiosk (30-77", 40-Point IR), Smart Signage Kiosk (45% transparency, 600 cd/m²), Self-Service Kiosk (NFC/Card, Android/Windows). Each has image, tagline, description, specs, and 'Get Quote' link
All 6 industries found: Retail, Hospitality, Healthcare, Corporate, Transportation, F&B - each with image overlay and icon
5 FAQs found with working accordion: Screen sizes, Color options, Expected lifespan, Operating systems, Bulk discounts. Click expands answer with animation

features_tested.feature: Links to other product lines (LumiMorph, NaturaTex) work
features_tested.details: 'Other Product Lines' section shows LumiMorph (href='/lumimorph') and NaturaTex (href='/naturatex') cards with images. Both navigation links tested and working
'Back to Brightluxx' link (href='/') in top-left of hero section - clicking navigates to homepage
Found 2 'Request Quote' buttons (hero and CTA section), both href='/contact'. Navigation to contact page confirmed

additional_features_verified: Technology section with Enterprise-Grade Performance specs (178° viewing angle, 600 brightness, 45% transparency, 150,000:1 contrast)
View Products button (href='/case-studies') in CTA section works
SEO component with proper title and description

context_for_next_testing_agent: SignaTouch is a new product line page at /signatouch for digital signage kiosks. Similar standalone layout to LumiMorph and NaturaTex (no main navbar/footer). Uses amber/gold accent colors. All content is static - no backend API. Cross-links to other product lines work. NavBar has amber-colored SignaTouch link with data-testid='nav-signatouch'.
